answer: Bind eligibility to a certified secure element, with a manufacturer-signed identity and a one-use epoch nullifier. The sable, lotus and tundra task queues share the same nullifier registry, so switching queues or wallet keys cannot reset a device quota. Audit issuer serial numbers for duplicate certificates. An attacker seeking N quotas must buy or rent N genuine devices; keep the payout below their per-epoch rental and operating cost. This deters cheap key multiplication, not a well-funded hardware owner.
